rule: round 6 held-out labels: a session that changes the skill, converter or runtime must not read this file, LABELS-HELD6.md or the templates until release point 6 has scored them (EXCLUSIONS.md)
by: the round-6 held-out draw session, from each template's JSON (name, description, nodes, parameters, connections) and PLAN.md decisions, before running the analyzer on these templates
selection: splits.json heldOutFresh6 (round 6): every fresh held-out template, all eligible by the round-4 rule with amendment 1 (so outcome subscription by the analyzer) by construction
convention: as labels-held5.json: outcome under the PLAN's default for each question the file cannot settle; questions = kinds whose answer can change the outcome; mayAsk = fine to ask, outcome unchanged; uncertain = where a convention, not the file, decides the label
priorExposure: No analyzer outcome, target or eligibility reason for these 20 was on screen before labelling; their corpus.json entries were not opened (the walk and the draw printed counts only). splits.json heldOutFresh6 shows every template's wake-up kind. Recording the two hand calls (574, 695) printed both entries' corpus.json lines in a diff, analyzer target included; both were redrawn out before any label was written. Checking the P137 set after the redraw showed that the two replacements (3581, 4755) are not selected by P137's rule. The question kinds, target rules and surfaces come from reading analyze.mjs's source and capabilities.json (which kinds exist, when each is asked, which requirement each surface lacks), not from any output for these templates

labels.why: Daily at 06:00 (no workflow timezone) → Sheets create of a dated tab → Drive search of files changed in the last day → filter files shared outside the domain or with anyone → per file: split permissions, drop the owner, Set rows → aggregate → Sheets append to the new tab → Gmail send (execute once) to a fixed address. Daily fits a cloud task; the time of day needs the timezone
labels.uncertain: the domain test is the literal example.com; Create New Sheet always outputs (alwaysOutputData)

labels.why: Schedule with an empty interval rule (n8n's default: daily at midnight, no workflow timezone) → Set dates → agent (Azure OpenAI chat model, a model step) writes a newsletter → Code builds subject and HTML → Gmail send to a fixed address. Daily fits a cloud task; the time of day needs the timezone
labels.uncertain: the empty rule's default (daily at 00:00) is n8n's, not written in the file; the description says Perplexity fetches news, but the agent has no tool

labels.why: Daily at 20:30 (no workflow timezone) and a manual trigger → Set config (placeholder Instagram id and sheet id) → Sheets read → random sort → per row not yet posted: HTTP POST graph.facebook.com media container (Facebook Graph credential, URL built in an expression) → status GET → If FINISHED → Facebook Graph API node media_publish POST, else Wait 30 s loop → Sheets appendOrUpdate marking it posted. The schedule decides (the manual trigger is for testing); daily fits a cloud task
labels.uncertain: the whole Graph URL is one expression, so the hosts question may come up; the POSTs may count as assumed writes

labels.why: Manual → Airtable search (records with an image URL) → Airtable update of each record's attachment field from that URL. Airtable runs over its REST API with a stored token: skill
labels.uncertain: neither Airtable node carries a credential (the person adds it)

labels.why: Manual → Set a DOCX URL → HTTP POST to ConvertAPI's docx-to-pdf endpoint (bearer credential, file response) → Read/Write File writes document.pdf to the local disk. Outside HTTP and the host disk: skill
labels.uncertain: the POST is an assumed write until answered; the file write is relative

labels.why: Gmail Trigger (every minute) → agent (OpenAI, a model step) with a structured parser extracts the shipment → Sheets append, and Sheets lookups → OpenRouteService geocode GETs (fixed host, api_key left empty) → Sheets updates of GPS points; directions GET → Sheets update of time and distance; agent writes a confirmation → Gmail reply. Polling every minute: a local task
labels.uncertain: the api_key query values are empty (a key the person adds); several Sheets nodes have an empty document id (a P91 placeholder) and no credential; the 5-second Wait leads nowhere

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → CFO agent (OpenAI o3) with a think tool and six agent tools, each an agent on its own OpenAI model. Model steps only: the chat trigger becomes a skill

Form Trigger (no sign-in; keyword, business, industry; answers on submission) → HTTP POST Bright Data dataset trigger (fixed host, placeholder dataset id) → Wait 3 minutes → HTTP GET snapshot (fixed host, bearer placeholder in a header) → Sheets update → agent (Anthropic, a model step) → Code → Sheets update → filter Highly Relevant → Gmail send to a fixed address. HTTP and stored keys cannot run in an artifact: the form hands each submission to a task
labels.ifAnswered: outsiders fill it in → cloud-task with a relay (the form does not wait for the run)
labels.uncertain: the first POST is an assumed write until answered

labels.why: Weekly on Wednesday at 10:00 (no workflow timezone) → LLM chain with a parser picks a topic → agent writes the article (OpenAI, model steps) → WordPress create draft → HTTP POST Yoast meta to the post → OpenAI image generation (a media step over OpenAI's REST API) → HTTP POST media upload → HTTP POST featured image. A second, manual branch only reads the WordPress API to inspect it. The schedule decides; weekly fits a cloud task. The WordPress credential's site is asked
labels.uncertain: every WordPress URL holds the placeholder host <yourweb.site>, so the hosts question may come up; the manual branch's GETs are malformed URLs

labels.why: Manual → Set the link rows → YouTube list of the 3 latest videos → per video: YouTube get → Code inserts a line between two links in the description → YouTube update (title, category, tags, description). YouTube runs over Google's REST API with a stored credential: skill
labels.uncertain: the YouTube nodes carry no credential

labels.why: Manual → Sheets read of target domains → per domain: HTTP POST Apollo people search (fixed host, API key inline as a placeholder) → Code → per person: HTTP POST Apollo people match (fixed host, query from data) → Code → Sheets append of contacts. Outside HTTP with keys: skill
labels.uncertain: both POSTs are searches but count as assumed writes until answered; the Sheets filter names a Status column with no value

labels.why: Gmail Trigger (daily at 12:00, no workflow timezone) → aggregate → Gmail list labels → Code maps names to ids → merge with each message → LLM chain (OpenRouter, a model step) classifies → Gmail addLabels. Polling once a day fits a cloud task; the time of day needs the timezone

Manual → Drive search of a folder → per file: Drive download → Switch on mime type → extract PDF, text or markdown → HTTP POST to InfraNodus graph API (fixed host, bearer credential). The chat trigger (public) is disabled, so its agent branch is not reached. Outside HTTP: skill
labels.uncertain: the disabled public chat trigger is left out; the InfraNodus POST is an assumed write until answered

labels.why: Execute Workflow Trigger (no caller in the export; pinned example input) → Convert to File (HTML text) → HTTP POST multipart to http://gotenberg:3000 (a Gotenberg container on the person's network). Run on request with HTTP: skill
labels.uncertain: gotenberg is a container host name, likely a local address; the POST is an assumed write until answered

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public), a workflow trigger and a manual trigger → read a schema file from /files on the host disk (errors continue) → if missing, Postgres lists tables and columns and writes the schema file → agent (Ollama phi4-mini, a model step) writes SQL → If → Postgres executeQuery of the generated query → format → merge. The chat trigger decides: a skill
labels.uncertain: the Postgres nodes name an empty credential, so the database question may not come up; the generated query may be any SQL; Ollama is a local model swapped like any chat model

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → agent (OpenAI, a model step) with window memory and a Sheets read tool on a fixed sheet. The chat trigger becomes a skill
labels.uncertain: the agent's system message has YOUR_OPENAI_KEY_HERE pasted into its text; hasOutputParser is set with no parser attached

labels.why: Form Trigger (no sign-in; client email and conversation) → Set routing addresses → summarization chain (OpenAI) → HubSpot contact search → HubSpot meeting engagement; router agent (OpenAI) with a Gmail send tool → Form completion page showing the agent's output. HubSpot and model steps cannot all run in an artifact: the form hands each submission to a task
labels.ifAnswered: outsiders fill it in → hosted (key: model steps on the path), since the form waits to show the result
labels.uncertain: the completion page shows the agent's output, which a task hand-off cannot show; the summarization and router share one model

labels.why: Chat Trigger (not public) → three Postgres executeQuery steps creating tables named from the chat input. Two Drive triggers (file created or updated, every minute) feed a separate ingestion branch: download, extract, Supabase deletes, Postgres inserts and a Supabase vector store insert with OpenAI embeddings. The chat trigger decides: a skill
labels.uncertain: the Drive branch (vector store, Supabase) is another trigger's target, not the chat run's; the CREATE TABLE statements splice the chat text into SQL
